answer: Authority flows through UCAN delegation chains where each link carries an expiry and a scope, and the panel verifies the whole chain, so a delegation cannot outlive its grant or exceed its scope. A farm chaining a thousand delegations must keep every link unexpired and in scope, while one honest agent delegates once and the chain verifies itself. The sable of the design is public, the echo of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the lantern of honest work is what finally pays.
